title: VP, Global Product & Quality Excellence
text:
**Description**
The Opportunity
 
 
Power Integrations is seeking an exceptional executive to redefine quality as a strategic competitive advantage. This leader will transform quality from a functional discipline into an enterprise capability that accelerates innovation, strengthens customer confidence, improves product reliability and enables profitable growth. As a fabless semiconductor company, the role spans the entire product lifecycle—from architecture through field performance—while driving excellence across external wafer fabrication, assembly and test partners.
 
 
Mission
 
 
Build a world-class Product & Quality Excellence organization that embeds quality into every engineering decision, every supplier relationship and every customer experience.
 
 
Executive Mandate
 
 

* Create an enterprise-wide Quality First culture where quality is designed into products rather than inspected into them.
* Own end-to-end product quality, reliability engineering, supplier quality, customer quality and quality systems.
* Partner with Engineering to strengthen Design for Quality, verification, failure analysis and reliability methodologies.
* Lead quality across outsourced manufacturing partners, ensuring robust process controls, change management and continuous improvement.
* Establish executive quality governance, enterprise KPIs and Board-level reporting.

First-Year Transformation Priorities
 
 
**First 90 Days:**
Assess product quality, reliability, supplier performance, customer escalations, organizational capability and quality systems. Build executive alignment and establish the transformation roadmap.
 
 
**90–180 Days:**
Launch Design for Quality, supplier excellence and customer quality initiatives. Implement enterprise dashboards, governance and standardized quality reviews.
 
 
**180–365 Days:**
Deliver measurable improvements in field reliability, manufacturing quality, supplier performance, customer satisfaction and organizational quality maturity while building a sustainable culture of continuous improvement.
 
 
Measures of Success
 
 

* Reduced field failures and customer returns
* Improved product reliability and qualification effectiveness
* Higher supplier quality and manufacturing yields
* Reduced Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)
* Faster root cause analysis and corrective actions
* Improved customer satisfaction and strategic account confidence
* Enterprise adoption of a Quality First mindset

Ideal Executive Profile
 
 

* 20+ years of semiconductor industry leadership with significant experience in analog, mixed-signal or power semiconductors.
* Executive leadership in product quality, reliability engineering, supplier quality and customer quality.
* Experience operating within a fabless semiconductor model using external manufacturing partners.
* Demonstrated success leading enterprise transformation and influencing executive leadership and Boards.
* Technical depth combined with strategic business acumen and exceptional leadership.

Leadership Competencies
 
 

* Enterprise leadership and systems thinking
* Strategic quality transformation
* Engineering partnership and technical credibility
* Customer obsession
* Data-driven decision making
* Global influence without authority
* Talent development and succession planning
* Executive communication and Board presence

Power Integrations is committed to building teams that drive innovation and therefore review a range of factors when determining compensation.
 
 
Power Integrations also offers to our eligible employees a comprehensive total rewards package that includes equity, medical benefits, ESPP, 401K, tuition reimbursement and time off programs. For additional benefits, please visit
**https://www.power.com/company/our-sustainability-priorities/people-our-engine-innovation**
.
